summary: __thiscall dispatcher that selects one of two guarded subroutines based on a flag bit (0x8) at byte offset +32 of argument a2. When the bit is set it calls sub_557670(a2); otherwise it calls sub_557CE0(this, a2). Either callee returning non-zero makes the function return -1; otherwise it returns 0. The 'this' pointer is forwarded only to the else-branch callee.

operations.description: Read the byte at a2 + 32 and test bit 0x8 to choose between the two branches.
When flag bit 0x8 is set, call sub_557670(a2); a non-zero return value causes the function to return -1.
When flag bit 0x8 is clear, call sub_557CE0(this, a2); a non-zero return value causes the function to return -1.
Return -1 if the selected guarded callee reported failure, otherwise return 0.

unresolved: Meaning of argument a2 and the flag semantics of bit 0x8 at a2 + 32.
